changelog:
• SoundWave Jam: Listen together in real-time with friends
• Zero-setup guest joining: Friends can join without any API key or setup
• Spotify-style secure 6-character room codes & QR code invites
• Dual sync engines: Sub-millisecond Local Wi-Fi (LAN) & Cloud sync
• Android 10 (API 29) compatibility fix and system stability improvements
• Fixed queue deduplication and guest playback synchronization
• Miniplayer motion and bottom sheet alignment polish
